thread:
mari: quick ask — can we surface marginal per-token cost for canary routing in the cost dashboard? current view is too aggregated and hides multi-model chain effects.

liam: yes. we should show a split: model compute vs kv-cache savings vs batching amortization. ops needs to see what a 10% shift to variant B costs. :eyes:

jess: we already emit cache_hit boolean per invocation but it never made it into the billing model. plausible plan: add a cost_detail tag with model_sku, quantization, kv_cache_hit, batch_size. then we can roll up properly.

oliver: UX idea — add a "canary preview" toggle on the timeseries. hover a point -> show a simulated bill if route traffic was X% redirected to variant. also inline micro-summaries: "delta $ / 100k requests". mock attached in Figma but small. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

mari: also proposing an internal API param for deeper traces: `?cost_explain=full` that returns per-token/per-stage breakdown in the trace payload. example response sketch in thread: 
```
{
  "cost_explain": "per_token",
  "stages": [
    {"name":"embed","model":"open-embed-1","tokens":12,"compute_us":1200,"kv_hits":3},
    {"name":"decode","model":"rwd-3b-q4","tokens":64,"compute_us":8200,"kv_hits":55}
  ]
}
```

liam: we need to be careful with size. returning full per-token arrays for all requests will blow up telemetry volume. make it sampled and opt-in per-route. we can also compress to run-lengths for repeated token costs.

jess: sampling is fine. propose route-config fields: `cost_explain_sampling_rate` (float), `cost_explain_mode` (summary|per_token). default sampling_rate=0.01. backfill option: we can run offline recon to compute missing deltas for last 30d.

oliver: tiny UX nudge — move the cache-savings metric next to latency slider in the panel so PMs can toggle throughput/latency and immediately see cost delta. also add an annotation for quantization policy used in the period.

mari: sounds good. liam can you create FE ticket and link to infra schema change? i'll own product spec. :+1:

liam: created FE-1421 (canary cost preview + hover simulation) and ENG-5234 (telemetry schema: cost_detail). added labels: telemetry, cost-dashboard, rollouts. pinged @eng-infra in the ticket.

jess: I'll draft migration script to backfill `cost_detail` for last 30d using existing logs and kv hit heuristics. will need a short maintenance window for the cheap join job.

deploy-bot: Deployment pipeline kicked by @liam — job 8842 queued, will deploy to staging in 10m.

mari: perfect. i'll add the Figma mocks to FE-1421 and include example CSVs for pricing. meeting Thurs 10am to review end-to-end.

liam: note for infra — we should version the telemetry schema (v2) so older dashboards don't break while we roll out sampling and backfill.

jess: agreed. will include schema_version and migration plan in ENG-5234.

mari: thanks team. small win if we can show "simulated canary bill" in the console before rollout — should reduce surprises during enterprise demos.

oliver: happy to help polish the hover microcopy and the delta visualization.

mari: assigning follow-ups in the ticket. bye for now.
